For a model built over only a subset of the network’s snapshots, `solve_model` passes `n.snapshots` to `_call_extra_functionality`, rather than reading the model’s stored snapshots. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_as_model_snapshots` returns that full index unchanged, so the callback receives more snapshots than the model was built over.
